{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders and refunded orders
filtered_df = df[
    (df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99) &
    (df['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Check the final population
print(f'Final number of orders: {len(filtered_df)}')

# Check channel and segment distribution
print('\nChannel distribution:')
print(filtered_df['channel'].value_counts())

print('\nCustomer segment distribution:')
print(filtered_df['customer_segment'].value_counts())

# Check for confounding: is channel associated with segment?
print('\nCross-tabulation of channel vs customer_segment:')
print(pd.crosstab(filtered_df['channel'], filtered_df['customer_segment']))"}
